title: Infusions and injections
desc: A medication catalog with the usual dose and route (IV infusion, IV push, intramuscular, subcutaneous) and a session log: when, how much, how, where, how it was tolerated. Entries go into the feed, the doctor report and the AI context.

ai.title: Ask AI about infusions and injections
ai.desc: The fast model sees the catalog, the session log and the profile: what the medication is, how it combines with the main therapy, what to check before a course, how past sessions were tolerated.

empty.title: The first entry will appear here
empty.desc: Click a medication above to record a session. The dose comes from the catalog, and you can adjust it.

course.title: Course
course.intro: A course is a plan: how many infusions or injections and how often. Sessions of this medication go into the active course automatically, the count goes up, and the course closes when the plan is reached. If you set a frequency, a Telegram reminder arrives on the day of the next infusion.
course.introDevice: A course is a plan: how many infusions or injections and how often. Sessions of this medication go into the active course automatically, the count goes up, and the course closes when the plan is reached. If you set a frequency, the iPad reminds you on the day of the next infusion.
course.name: Name (optional)
course.confirmRemove: Delete the course? Recorded sessions will stay but will be unlinked from it.
